newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Exploding cell phone injures Brazilian policeman.
newsitem.headline: Exploding cell phone injures Brazilian policeman.

text.p: A Brazilian policeman suffered third degree burns on his leg and hip when the cellular telephone he was carrying on his belt exploded, authorities said on Tuesday.
"I think I would have been killed if I was using it at the time," Military Police Col. Walcir Ferreira da Costa told O Globo newspaper.
A police spokesman in Montes Claros in the state of Minas Gerais said laboratory technicians who examined the phone were at a loss to explain the accident, which occurred on Sunday.
The spokesman said he did not know who manufactured the cell phone.
